psychological_meaning: Shamrock green is strongly associated with nature, growth, and renewal. It evokes feelings of freshness, vitality, and peace. This color also symbolizes good luck, harmony, and stability, often linked to Irish culture and celebrations. It promotes a sense of well-being and connection to the natural world.
